name: Model router plugin: virtual model ids with pluggable priority + round-robin routing
description:
EPIC / wayfinder map.

DESTINATION: a DSH plugin (package dsh-model-router, repo /home/andre/git/dsh-model-router) that lets the user declare VIRTUAL model ids in config, each bound to a routing ALGORITHM (priority, round-robin; more later) over a list of real provider/model candidates. Using the virtual id anywhere (agent options, model picker) transparently dispatches to a real provider chosen by the algorithm. The algorithm set must be pluggable so future types don't restructure the design.

NOTES:
- Seam = SHIM ADAPTER: register a real LlmAdapter under a virtual provider route (e.g. 'fake') via ctx.llm.registerAdapter. The virtual id stays durable in session logs/request header (agent loop stamps request.provider/model from the virtual route), so resume/replay are safe. Works for every llm consumer.
- Failover = agent/request-error waterfall: on error finish the agent loop re-runs buildRequest when a listener returns {kind:'retry'} (same seam as shipped dsh-llm-retry). Router marks candidate failed, advances, returns retry; max attempts = candidate count.
- No source changes to other plugins or the harness itself: both seams are public extension points the shipped deepseek/pi-ai/retry plugins already use.
- Reference packages (read-only): @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm (LlmRuntime/LlmAdapter), dsh-llm-deepseek (apply/inject pattern), dsh-llm-retry (agent/request-error), dsh-agent-loop (prepareCall/buildRequest), dsh-scope (scopeTarget/createScope), cordis-plugin-include/loader (cordis.yml).
- Known limitation to record: round-robin changes the real model across requests, so resume/retry can land on a different real model than produced earlier history (breaks KV-cache prefix). Accepted.

SCOPE: virtual-id routing only. Out of scope: persistence of round-robin cursor (in-memory v1), in-stream re-routing, retry policy ownership (left to dsh-llm-retry), settings UI for the route table.

name: Implement round-robin algorithm (in-memory cursor)
description:
TASK. Implement the round-robin routing algorithm.

SEMANTICS: select() rotates among live candidates on each new request (in-memory cursor, resets on restart/HMR). onFailure() advances so the retry lands on the next live candidate, skipping the failed one. Persistence is OUT OF SCOPE for v1 (in-memory only).

ACCEPTANCE: consecutive requests rotate; a failed candidate is skipped on retry. Unit-testable pure selector + cursor logic.

BLOCKED BY: scaffold ticket (algorithm registry interface must exist first).

name: Prototype: shim-adapter delegation + retry-seam re-dispatch
description:
TASK (prototype). Prove the routing core before building.

QUESTION: can a shim adapter (registered under a virtual provider 'fake') delegate a prepared call to a REAL registered adapter's stream without breaking the agent loop's reconstruction invariant, and can agent/request-error re-dispatch land on the next candidate?

APPROACH:
1. Standalone stub (not the full plugin) that:
   - registers a shim LlmAdapter under route 'fake' via ctx.llm.registerAdapter,
   - in prepareCall('fake', model, signal) resolves a real provider/model from a hardcoded route map, looks up the real registration, and delegates to the real adapter's prepareCall(...).stream(...),
   - registers an agent/request-error listener that, for provider==='fake', advances the router and returns {kind:'retry'} up to candidate count.
2. Wire it beside a real adapter (dsh-llm-deepseek) in a scratch profile or test harness.
3. Verify: (a) session log names 'fake/fake-model-routed' in request/header and assistant/message source; (b) a failed first candidate triggers a retry that dispatches the second candidate; (c) the agent-loop-invariant does not fail (isAgentLoopRequest guard skips the rewritten, unmarked options object); (d) llm/stream middleware running twice is understood and bounded.

ASSET: throwaway prototype code + a short findings note. Do NOT build the real plugin here.

BLOCKED BY: nothing (first frontier task). This ticket resolves a DECISION: exact delegation/re-dispatch mechanics, before scaffold.
result: Prototype proven (4/4 tests green, exit 0, reviewer APPROVE round 1). 1) Shim delegation: shim adapter registered under virtual provider 'fake' delegates prepareCall to the real adapter via direct registry lookup (ctx.llm.registration(realProvider).adapter.prepareCall) — no recursion, no re-entry into llm/stream waterfall (measured 1 llm/stream firing per request, same as direct). Prepared call keeps virtual config; provider/model rewritten only inside the stream-forwarding closure; real adapter never reads options.provider. 2) Agent-loop reconstruction invariant: real invariant logic runs on outer waterfall with the virtual request and passes (shim preserves model/system/temperature/maxTokens/stop/tools; invariant never compares provider). 3) Failover: agent/request-error listener returns {kind:retry} only while candidates remain (bounded by failed-set monotonic growth); exhaustion returns undefined → error surfaces. Mid-stream failure in 'alpha' genuinely re-dispatches to 'beta'. 4) Design constraints for plugin: per-request candidate state on shim keyed (provider,model); shim must declare own providerRetryPolicy stance since dsh-llm-retry consumes retryable codes before downstream listeners see them; prepared config must stay virtual for callConfigEquals/normalizeModelInfo. Files: prototype/{Mock-adapters,Shim,Delegation-proof}.mjs + README. Workflow: strong-orchestrator, implementer (default model — skill-specified opencode-go/muse-spark-1.2-contributor returned null on 3 smoke tests) + reviewer free/opencode-zen/x-preview-f-free.

name: Implement priority algorithm (ordered failover)
description:
TASK. Implement the priority routing algorithm.

SEMANTICS: candidates are ordered. select() returns the first candidate whose real provider has a live registered adapter (ctx.llm.listProviders()/registration lookup). onFailure() advances past the failed candidate so the agent/request-error retry selects the next; when the last candidate fails, stop retrying (no {kind:'retry'}).

ACCEPTANCE: priority route fails over candidate-by-candidate on dispatch failure, and stops after exhausting the list. Unit-testable pure selector + the onFailure cursor logic.

BLOCKED BY: scaffold ticket (algorithm registry interface must exist first).
